description_en: Lists all findings under a specified analyzer. You can filter results by specifying filter conditions
description_zh: 列出指定 Analyzer 下的所有 Finding，支持通过筛选条件过滤结果
kebab_example: aliyun accessanalyzer list-findings --filter '[{"MatchType":"Equals","Values":["ACS::OSS::Bucket"],"Key":"ResourceType"}]' --analyzer-name MyAnalyzer --max-results 10 --next-token eyJpbmRleCI6IjIifQ== --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListFindings

element_fields.help_en: The field name of the filter condition
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en: The list of values for the filter condition
element_fields.name: values

element_fields.help_en: The match type of the filter condition
element_fields.name: match_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of findings to return in a single request. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回的最大 Finding 数量，默认 100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Leave this parameter empty for the first request. For subsequent requests, use the NextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 分页标记，首次请求不填，后续请求使用上一次返回的 NextToken 值
parameters.name: next_token
